queries/camayoc_adversarially_proven_che:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_adversarially_proven_checks",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q4: which checks were PROVEN adversarial — a deliberate sabotage shown to flip them — and which were only asserted to work. An unbound proof column is the assertion-only population; the query never fills one in.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label ?provenBy WHERE { ?verification a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label . OPTIONAL { ?verification aegis:adversariallyProvenBy ?provenBy } } ORDER BY ?label",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_blocked_on_closed_depend:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_blocked_on_closed_dependency",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q7: work items blocked on a dependency that is already closed — the measured 14-day failure. The blockedOn edge is the stated dependency; whether it still holds is exactly this read-time join, never a stored judgment.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX quechua: <https://scbrown.github.io/quechua/ns#> PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?item ?label ?dependency ?dependencyLabel ?closedAt WHERE { { ?item a aegis:WorkItem ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:blockedOn ?dependency . ?dependency rdfs:label ?dependencyLabel ; aegis:closedAt ?closedAt . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item aegis:closedAt ?itemClosed } } UNION { ?item a quechua:WorkItem ; rdfs:label ?label ; quechua:blockedOn ?dependency . ?dependency rdfs:label ?dependencyLabel ; aegis:closedAt ?closedAt . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item aegis:closedAt ?itemClosed } } UNION { ?item a schema:Action ; rdfs:label ?label ; quechua:blockedOn ?dependency . ?dependency rdfs:label ?dependencyLabel ; schema:endTime ?closedAt . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item schema:endTime ?itemClosed } } } ORDER BY ?label",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_blockers_by_evidence_kin:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_blockers_by_evidence_kind",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q10: blockers separated into stated (a claim) and built (a demonstrated failing case). The two were confused three times in one night.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX quechua: <https://scbrown.github.io/quechua/ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?blocker ?label ?evidence ?demonstratedBy WHERE { { ?blocker a aegis:Blocker ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:blockerEvidence ?evidence . OPTIONAL { ?blocker aegis:demonstratedBy ?demonstratedBy } } UNION { ?blocker a quechua:Blocker ; rdfs:label ?label ; quechua:blockerEvidence ?evidence . OPTIONAL { ?blocker quechua:demonstratedBy ?demonstratedBy } } } ORDER BY ?evidence ?label",
  "params": []
}
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_drifted_execution_paths",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q12: mechanisms whose installed artifact and repository source digests DIFFER — armed-not-running drift observed in the store. A path missing either digest is UNKNOWN and deliberately not returned: absence of measurement is never evidence of drift, nor of sync.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?path ?label ?artifactDigest ?sourceDigest WHERE { ?path a aegis:ExecutionPath ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:artifactDigest ?artifactDigest ; aegis:sourceDigest ?sourceDigest . FILTER(?artifactDigest != ?sourceDigest) } ORDER BY ?label",
  "params": []
}
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_gp_admissible_exemplars",
  "description": "golden-paths Q3: work items admissible as golden-path exemplars - closed done AND their trajectory produced a falsifier-gated Verification. A done work item whose checks cannot name their failing result is an anecdote and is excluded, which is the control this query is tested against.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX quechua: <https://scbrown.github.io/quechua/ns#> PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?workitem ?trajectory ?verification WHERE { { ?workitem a aegis:WorkItem ; aegis:outcome \"done\" . ?trajectory aegis:trajectoryOf ?workitem . ?step aegis:stepOf ?trajectory ; aegis:verifiedBy ?verification . ?verification aegis:falsifier ?f . } UNION { ?workitem a quechua:WorkItem ; quechua:outcome \"done\" . ?trajectory aegis:trajectoryOf ?workitem . ?step aegis:stepOf ?trajectory ; aegis:verifiedBy ?verification . ?verification aegis:falsifier ?f . } UNION { ?workitem a schema:Action ; quechua:outcome \"done\" . ?trajectory aegis:trajectoryOf ?workitem . ?step aegis:stepOf ?trajectory ; aegis:verifiedBy ?verification . ?verification aegis:falsifier ?f . } } ORDER BY ?workitem",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_gp_promotion_queue.json:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_gp_promotion_queue",
  "description": "golden-paths Q10: candidate paths awaiting human promotion - a candidate-level promotion exists, nothing higher does, and the path was not superseded. The queue is where 'we are involved in the process' is either true or quietly false.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?path ?label ?candidateAt WHERE { ?promo a aegis:PathPromotion ; aegis:promotes ?path ; aegis:blessingLevel \"candidate\" ; aegis:promotedAt ?candidateAt . ?path rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?p2 aegis:promotes ?path ; aegis:blessingLevel ?l2 . FILTER(?l2 IN (\"advisory\", \"blessed\", \"constraint-backing\")) } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?path aegis:supersededBy ?w } } ORDER BY ?candidateAt",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_gp_superseded_paths.json:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_gp_superseded_paths",
  "description": "golden-paths Q9: golden paths that were demoted by supersession, and what won. The old path is never deleted; this edge says who replaced it.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?path ?label ?winner WHERE { ?path a aegis:GoldenPath ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:supersededBy ?winner } ORDER BY ?label",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_metric_reachability_cand:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_metric_reachability_candidates",
  "description": "Q8 input: retrieval methods that must be executed to distinguish retrieved from unreachable. This query never fabricates a healthy verdict from method presence.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX quipu: <http://quipu.dev/ontology/> SELECT ?metric ?system ?query ?params WHERE { ?metric a aegis:Metric ; quipu:derivedBy ?method . ?method quipu:derivationSystem ?system ; quipu:derivationQuery ?query ; quipu:derivationParams ?params . } ORDER BY ?metric",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_sessions_without_usage.j:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_sessions_without_usage",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q19: sessions carrying NO usage record. These must read as UNKNOWN, never as zero — a missing measurement that aggregates as 0 is wrong in the flattering direction, and three of seven local sessions had none. Returning the sessions themselves is what keeps absence visible instead of summed away.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?session ?label WHERE { ?session a aegis:Session ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?record a aegis:UsageRecord ; aegis:inSession ?session } } ORDER BY ?label",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_single_owner_execution_p:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_single_owner_execution_paths",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q13: execution paths resolving into a location owned by a single principal rather than a shared, refreshed, read-only checkout. Observable execution-path risk, not a liveness judgment.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?path ?label ?owner WHERE { ?path a aegis:ExecutionPath ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:ownedBy ?owner . } ORDER BY ?owner ?label",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_unvalidated_metric_claim:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_unvalidated_metric_claims",
  "description": "Q4: metric-to-requirement claims whose probe has no falsifier-gated validation. Absence is reported as unvalidated, never as valid.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?metric ?metricLabel ?requirement ?probe WHERE { ?metric a aegis:Metric ; rdfs:label ?metricLabel ; aegis:measuresRequirement ?requirement ; aegis:probe ?probe . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?metric aegis:probeValidatedBy ?verification . ?verification a aegis:Verification ; aegis:falsifier ?falsifier . } } ORDER BY ?metricLabel",
  "params": []
}
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_verification_population",
  "description": "The accepted Verification population — the DENOMINATOR docs/design/incident-corpus.md §4.2 says the corpus lacks, read by scripts/refusal_denominator.py and joined against quipu's write.refused event stream. Deliberately not mapped to a competency question: it answers no question about the domain, it supplies the other half of a ratio, and the ratio itself is computed at read time and never stored. Note what it CANNOT be narrowed to: the refusal stream does not keep refused fact bodies, so this population cannot be split to match a per-form refusal breakdown that does not exist.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label WHERE { ?verification a aegis:Verification . OPTIONAL { ?verification rdfs:label ?label } } ORDER BY ?verification",
  "params": []
}
queries/camayoc_verifications_without_fa:
{
  "action": "load",
  "name": "camayoc_verifications_without_falsifier",
  "description": "verification-and-liveness Q2: verifications carrying no falsifier \u2014 assertions wearing a verification's clothes. Structurally empty for gated writes; non-empty only for data that entered before the M1 shape or around it, which is exactly what it is for.",
  "template": "PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label WHERE { ?verification a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?verification aegis:falsifier ?f } } ORDER BY ?label",
  "params": []
}
